items.headline: OpenAI president Greg Brockman says company could be IPO ready in 2027
items.excerpt: OpenAI President Greg Brockman says the company could be ready to go public in 2027, pointing to accelerating enterprise revenue and a turnaround in its business.

items.headline: Claude can now analyze your spending with its new Personal Finance tool
items.excerpt: With Personal Finance in Claude, users can connect their bank and card accounts through Plaid and ask questions about their finances.

items.headline: Axiom Math wants to keep AI slop out of mathematics
items.excerpt: As AI floods math with unchecked proofs, Axiom Math is betting on verification. The startup’s AI agents just formally verified the Stacks Project, one of the field’s biggest libraries.

items.headline: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
items.excerpt: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.

items.headline: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick, and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
items.excerpt: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.

items.headline: Box taps Nvidia’s Nemotron for new agent-first content retrieval system
items.excerpt: The system can supposedly answer queries four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens used.

items.headline: A YC startup is putting $1M behind 5 unsolved materials science problems for AI
items.excerpt: While frontier AI models have solved a remarkable series of outstanding mathematics problems and made progress in the life sciences, they have yet to truly plumb the complex physics in advanced materials.

items.headline: Agility is the first pure humanoid robot company on the stock market. Are you buying?
items.excerpt: Agility arrives on the Nasdaq today as the first publicly traded pure-play humanoid robotics company.

items.headline: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage

items.headline: After the midterms, a bigger clash over data centers could be coming
items.excerpt: Data center opposition crossed party lines in Tuesday’s midterms.

items.headline: AI PACs spent millions trying to shape Congress — here’s how they fared
items.excerpt: AI industry PACs spent millions influencing the 2026 midterms, with mixed results. Political groups are already looking toward the next election cycle.

items.headline: Nothing CEO says company’s mysterious AI-first device is dropping next month
items.excerpt: While it's not yet clear what kind of product the smartphone startup is cooking up, Nothing's CEO said the product is designed to leverage AI for productivity gains.

items.headline: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
items.excerpt: During its busiest week last quarter, Uber said only four people booked a ride using an AI agent.

items.headline: OpenAI is already trying to shape the 2028 election
items.excerpt: OpenAI’s Chris Lehane wants AI to define the 2028 election, proposing a new social contract that could benefit Americans while also advancing the AI giant’s own business interests.

items.headline: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
items.excerpt: The startup allows software engineers to deploy teams of agents to work on various aspects of a project simultaneously.
